decisions.reason: As a strategically central transactional email cloud service, it remains closely aligned with the firm's direction in secure multichannel business communications despite lower recent website visibility.

It still supports compliant digital document workflows for business and public-sector customers, but its weaker visibility suggests a moderate risk of deprioritization versus the firm's core messaging services.
As a narrow fax-specific optimization feature, it is the most likely offer to be folded into the base platform or discontinued as investment shifts toward broader cloud and digital workflow services.
Threat protection remains important to the firm's secure messaging proposition, so this offer is still worth retaining even if it is less prominent than the main communication services.
